scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @magguarantee/shared && npm run build -w @magguarantee/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
